consequence.statement: Differences in status fields are no longer detected for all resources by default; users relying on status being part of desired state see different diff results.
consequence.remediation: Set ignoreResourceStatusField: crd in resource.compareoptions of argocd-cm to preserve the v2 default.

assertion.statement: The default of ignoreResourceStatusField in argocd-cm resource.compareoptions changed from `crd` to `all`, so status field differences are no longer detected for any resource.
